Implements `RunLogStore` using `R2Bucket`:
- `begin` — PUTs an empty `chunk-0.ndjson` under `runs/<companyId>/<agentId>/<runId>/`.
- `append` — reads the active shard, appends the NDJSON line, re-PUTs; spills to `chunk-N+1` when the shard would exceed 128 KiB.
- `finalize` — lists all shards via `bucket.list`, concatenates content, computes SHA-256 via `crypto.subtle`.
- `read` — concatenates all shards, slices the byte range, returns `content` + `nextOffset`.
- Web APIs only (`TextEncoder`/`Decoder`, `crypto.subtle`, `R2Bucket` binding). No `node:*` imports.
- `handle.store` discriminant is `"r2"`.
